{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to correct for overestimation bias.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to avoid lagged reactions.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment strongly bullish.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp upward spikes (e.g., >15% from prior day) by 10-20% to prevent overcorrection.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, slightly increase forecast horizon for next 3-5 days to capture momentum.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3+ consecutive days), apply downward bias correction by 3-5% per day.",
    "For sentiment = 0.50, increase forecast by 2-5% to account for potential bullish momentum, but cap at 10% above recent high."
  ]
}
